Jewish artists and actors support Mark Ruffalo amid antisemitism claims

Over 180 Jewish artists and entertainers, including actors Jonathan Glazer and Joaquin Phoenix, have signed an open letter supporting Mark Ruffalo. The letter was released following accusations of antisemitism leveled against Ruffalo. Actor George Clooney also defended Ruffalo, calling the accusations "ridiculous."
